Thanks for the quick sync — agreed outcome below so recruiting can proceed.

Consensus: Send a short take-home assignment focused on a small infra design + cost/latency tradeoff ( ~6 hours effort, asynchronous ).
Owner: Harper Labs Recruiting to send candidate details and timeline; Chloe will draft the assignment and share with recruiting by EOD.
Rationale: Communication and system instincts strong; want to probe deeper on GPU scheduling and end-to-end ownership before inviting onsite.

Action items:
- Chloe: draft assignment and example rubric (by EOD)
- Laura: provide 2 targeted evaluation questions for GPU scheduling (ASAP)
- Vivek/Markus: review assignment draft (quick turn)

Chloe will loop candidate directly with Harper CC'd once assignment is ready.

Attachment: none (assignment draft to follow).
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Subject: Next step: take-home assignment for Senior Data Infrastructure role

Hi Lucy — thanks again for interviewing with Redwood today. The interview panel liked your communication and system thinking. We'd like to move you forward to a short take-home assignment to better understand your approach to GPU scheduling and tradeoffs with caching/batching.

What to expect:
- 1 design prompt + 2 short implementation questions (estimated effort: 4–6 hours).
- Submission window: 7 days.
- We will share an evaluation rubric and a sample dataset.

Harper Labs recruiting — please share logistics and confirm timeline with Lucy; I will attach the assignment and rubric once final.

Thanks — looking forward to your response.

Best,
